name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 27 February 2026 amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1241 as regards the establishment of measures to ensure compliance with existing mitigation measures to reduce incidental catches of the resident population of the Baltic Proper harbour porpoise (Phocoena phocoena) in the Baltic Sea
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a European Commission rule on protecting Baltic harbour porpoises. The rule would have made small fishing boats under 12 metres long carry tracking devices and send their position every 10 minutes. Parliament says this burdens small-scale fishers without proof it is needed, without money to cover the costs, and without fair treatment when equipment fails. Parliament asks the Commission to come back within nine months with a new, better-prepared rule.

- **What changes:** The tracking rule for small boats is stopped and must be rewritten.
- **Who it affects:** Small-scale coastal fishers in the Baltic Sea, and harbour porpoise protection.
- **What happens next:** The Commission has nine months to propose a new rule with impact studies, funding and safeguards.
